blocks.caption: The teacher gives the class instructions.

blocks.md: When a teacher gives a **command**, they tell you to do something. You must listen and obey.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Class, all of you please stand up.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Aisha, go and shut the front door of the class.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Kunle, walk to the front of the classroom.

lines.speaker: Mohammed
lines.text: Kunle has walked to the front of the classroom.

blocks.md: **Remember:** Action words like **stand**, **sit**, **shut**, and **walk** are called **verbs**.

quiz.q: If the teacher says 'stand up', what do you do?
quiz.explain: 'Stand up' means to get on your feet.
The teacher asked her to shut the door, and she did.
'Sit' is an action you are told to do.
